lines: {target}? Dry cliffs make every mistake echo. I would stay close enough to hear the bell.
If anyone heads for Badlands, tell them: Carry water and watch the ledges. I will be at the bell.
Red sand and terracotta do not soften a fall. I will remember that from near the bell.
Badlands is no small story. Running the wrong way is still running.
I will remember Badlands as hard country with old color in its bones. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
